answer: Replicating one identity costs 0.4 CPU-hours of signed work, 3 attestations, and 1 bond. An audit voids if its panel is not diverse, so 500 clones must each clear a jury drawn from 5 separate hosts, and no identity audits its own recruit. Below a 40 percent pass rate the kernel is a fable and the farm is a hollow shell on the ledger.
